name: Amazon RDS
description: Managed relational database service on AWS that automates provisioning, patching, and backups for engines such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.

name: Amazon Redshift
description: Fully managed cloud data warehouse service on AWS designed for large-scale data analytics and complex queries.

name: Azure SQL Database
description: Managed relational database service on Microsoft Azure based on SQL Server, handling maintenance, scaling, and backups automatically.

name: Google BigQuery
description: Serverless, fully managed data warehouse on Google Cloud used for running large-scale SQL analytics over big datasets.

name: H2 Database
description: Lightweight, open-source relational database written in Java, often used for embedded applications and automated testing due to its small footprint.

name: IBM Db2
description: Relational database management system from IBM used for enterprise data storage, transaction processing, and analytics.

name: IBM Db2 for LUW
description: Edition of IBM's Db2 database designed to run on Linux, Unix, and Windows operating systems.

name: JDBC
description: Java API that provides a standard way for applications to connect to and execute queries against relational databases.

name: MariaDB
description: Open-source relational database management system originally forked from MySQL, used for structured data storage and SQL-based querying.

name: Microsoft Access
description: Desktop database application from Microsoft that pairs a relational database engine with graphical tools for building small business data applications.

name: Microsoft SQL Server
description: Relational database management system from Microsoft used for enterprise transaction processing, data storage, and business intelligence workloads.

name: MySQL
description: Open-source relational database management system widely used to store and query structured data in web and enterprise applications.

name: Oracle Database
description: Enterprise relational database management system known for handling large-scale transactional and analytical workloads with high reliability.

name: PostgreSQL
description: Open-source object-relational database system known for standards compliance, extensibility, and support for advanced data types and indexing.

name: Snowflake
description: Cloud-based data warehousing platform that separates storage and compute resources, used for analytics and large-scale data processing.

name: SQLite
description: Lightweight, serverless relational database engine embedded directly into applications, commonly used for local or mobile data storage.

name: Supabase
description: Open-source backend-as-a-service platform built on PostgreSQL that provides authentication, real-time data sync, and auto-generated APIs for app development.

name: Sybase (SAP ASE)
description: Relational database management system originally developed by Sybase and now owned by SAP, used for transaction processing in enterprise systems.

name: Vertica
description: Columnar analytical database management system designed for fast query performance on large-scale data warehousing and analytics workloads.
